A flowchart showing the sequential steps of land preparation. Step 1: "Land Clearing" showing a farmer with a cutlass slashing tall grass. Step 2: "Stumping" showing a pickaxe hitting a thick tree root. Step 3: "Ploughing (Primary Tillage)" showing a tractor with a disc plough turning over large clods of soil. Step 4: "Harrowing (Secondary Tillage)" showing a tractor breaking clods into finer soil. Step 5: "Ridging" showing neat heaps/ridges of soil.

A side-by-side comparison diagram. Left side: "Conventional Tillage" showing bare, loose soil in ridges, vulnerable to a rainstorm washing soil down the slope (erosion). Right side: "Zero Tillage" showing soil covered with dead plant residue (mulch) and new maize plants growing straight out of small slits in the soil, with rain hitting the mulch and soaking in without washing soil away.
